column1: # MODES.tsv — the DECLARED grading mode per family. hq_C FORMAT RULING (TRIO 2026-08-29):
# DECLARED, NEVER DERIVED. A family absent from this file is UNKNOWN, which is UNPROVEN at
# grading time — never PASS, never FAIL — and is reported loudly by the builder.
# ⛔ Do NOT populate this by pattern-matching family names. The mode is a property of THE RUNNER;
# record what a runner actually does, with the runner named, or leave the family out.
# EVIDENCE (hq_P 2026-08-29; RE-MEASURED hq_P 2026-09-05 -- the 08-29 text below cited
# SUITES="$CORPUS/crosscheck", a directory that NO LONGER EXISTS: the loose pairs were absorbed
# into the ONE flat master and the gates were repointed at it. Both gates now read
# MASTER_SRC=$CORPUS/ALL.pas + MASTER_REF=$CORPUS/ALL.ref through corpus_suite_harness.py, so they
# still grade EVERY family in the master in both modes -- the conclusion is unchanged, the reason
# is not. A stale evidence string is worse than none: it reads as verified and cannot be checked.):
# Both modes grade every crosscheck family, so every family below is m3,m4 on runner evidence.

column3: # test_pascal_ladder.sh:12 -- "EACH WITNESS RUNS ALONE IN BOTH MODES: m3 = scrip --run . m4 = scrip --compile -o x.s + as --64 + gcc -no-pie + run" (35 entries, ladder__rungNN_*)

# ⛔ AST, NOT m3,m4 -- these are graded by --dump-ast diff and NEVER EXECUTED. Evidence is the DATA, not just a comment: every parser__* ref in ALL.ref is an AST dump ("(STMT :subj (TT_PROC_DECL main ...") while a ladder__* ref beside it is program output ("7"). test_gate_pascal_m3.sh:63 says the same and passes --by-modes-column precisely so a plain --modes m3 cannot execute them. Declaring these m3,m4 runs a program whose ref is an AST dump -- it can never agree, and in the other direction (RUN entries declared ast) it is the false green the prolog master is carrying right now. (5 entries, parser__*)
